data.title: 加藤惠 · 厨房里的第一次翻面
data.description: 惠把头发束成马尾，穿白衬衫、柠檬黄围裙和深色长裤站在厨房里。她先用锅铲试着抬起煎蛋边缘，再专注地给它翻面；确认没有散开后，棕眼里浮出不易察觉的小得意。
data.action: 试抬煎蛋边缘后小心翻面，确认成功时浅笑。
data.mood: 新婚女友感、温馨烟火气
data.promptProse: Megumi Kato stands at the kitchen stove, testing the edge of a fried egg with her spatula before carefully turning it intact. Her white blouse, lemon-yellow apron and dark trousers remain tidy, brown ponytail kept away from the pan. The medium portrait includes the worktop and kitchen window behind. Clear window light falls on her focused eyes and apron, glinting along the spatula while the pan casts a compact shadow beneath its handle.
